concepts.gloss_en: house/home (esp. the Temple, the Beit HaMikdash; the built dwelling)

reason_for_human: All five occurrences are vocalized בַּיִת and mean 'house' in the same sense — the built dwelling, consistently identified with the Beit HaMikdash/Temple (building of the House, city of our God, courtyard-and-house external/internal, Rosh Bayit = Temple). No homograph is present; this is one word. I marked verdict 'revise' only because round-1 tied each occurrence to a different partner (דעת, עיר אלקינו, פנימיות, בתים של תפלין, בית המקדש) — those are relation edges, not separate concepts, so they collapse into a single 'house' concept.
